      Purchase options and add-ons

      • LIGHTWEIGHT AND COMFORTABLE WEAR: Made with 75 GSM EVA material, the rainsuit is light and easy to wear during travel or commutes. It provides reliable coverage while allowing free movement, suitable for walking, biking, or everyday use in wet weather.
      • TWO-PIECE FULL COVERAGE: Includes a full-sleeve jacket and matching pants for complete protection. Designed with an adjustable hood and secure cuffs, it helps keep water out during outdoor activities such as riding, hiking, or traveling in light to moderate rain.
      • WATER-RESISTANT CONSTRUCTION: Built to resist water during unexpected showers, it helps you stay dry while commuting, biking, or exploring outdoors. Ideal for short-term use in rainy conditions where staying dry and comfortable is important.
      • ADJUSTABLE FIT FEATUREs: The hood and cuffs can be adjusted for a snug fit that helps block rain. The pants have a stretchable waistband, providing ease of movement while keeping the set in place during various outdoor activities.
      • SUITABLE FOR ADVENTURES: This raincoat offers reliable weather protection for outdoor activities like trekking, camping, hiking, and daily commutes as its water-resistant material keeps you dry and comfortable during unexpected showers.

      About this Item

      • LIGHTWEIGHT AND COMFORTABLE WEAR: Made with 75 GSM EVA material, the rainsuit is light and easy to wear during travel or commutes. It provides reliable coverage while allowing free movement, suitable for walking, biking, or everyday use in wet weather.
      • TWO-PIECE FULL COVERAGE: Includes a full-sleeve jacket and matching pants for complete protection. Designed with an adjustable hood and secure cuffs, it helps keep water out during outdoor activities such as riding, hiking, or traveling in light to moderate rain.
      • WATER-RESISTANT CONSTRUCTION: Built to resist water during unexpected showers, it helps you stay dry while commuting, biking, or exploring outdoors. Ideal for short-term use in rainy conditions where staying dry and comfortable is important.
      • ADJUSTABLE FIT FEATUREs: The hood and cuffs can be adjusted for a snug fit that helps block rain. The pants have a stretchable waistband, providing ease of movement while keeping the set in place during various outdoor activities.
      • SUITABLE FOR ADVENTURES: This raincoat offers reliable weather protection for outdoor activities like trekking, camping, hiking, and daily commutes as its water-resistant material keeps you dry and comfortable during unexpected showers.

      Product description

      The Hacer EVA Rainsuit Set is a lightweight and practical solution for rainy days. Made from 75 GSM EVA material, it includes a full-sleeve jacket with an adjustable hood and matching pants. Water-resistant and easy to carry, it's ideal for bike riders, travelers, or daily commuters. Designed for quick wear and compact storage.
